cues.zh: brittonx2：冠状病毒的刺突由两部分连接而成；只有这两部分分开后，刺突才会激活，病毒才能进入宿主细胞。在经典 SARS 病毒中，这两部分不太容易分开。但在 SARS-CoV-2 中，连接两部分的桥可以被一种名为 furin 的酶轻易切开。这种酶由人体细胞产生，而且关键的是，存在于许多组织中。“这或许是我们观察到这种病毒一些极不寻常特征的重要原因。”Kristian Ander 说
cues.en: brittonx2: Coronavirus spikes consist of two connected halves, and the spike activates when those halves are separated; only then can the virus enter a host cell. In SARS-classic, this separation happens with some difficulty. But in SARS-CoV-2, the bridge that connects the two halves can be easily cut by an enzyme called furin, which is made by human cells and—crucially—is found across many tissues. “This is probably important for some of the really unusual things we see in this virus,” says Kristian Ander
